[SWS_Fim_91004] Definition of ClientServerInterface FunctionInhibitionCallback
Upstream requirements: SRS_Fim_04700
⌈
Name
FunctionInhibitionCallback
Comment
The SW Components can use this service to get informed on permission state changes of a
FID.
IsService
true
Variation
–
Possible Errors
0
E_OK
Operation successful
Operation
CBFidStatusChanged
Comment
–
Mapped to API
CBFidStatusChanged
Variation
–
Status
Type
FiM_FunctionIdType
Direction
IN
Comment
Set to INIT if the FiM is calling this callback due to the initialisation of the
module. If set to CHANGED, this callback indicates a FID state change
Variation
–
Permission
Type
boolean
Parameters
Direction
IN
▽
△
Comment
Indicates the initial/new FID permission state. TRUE: FID has permission to
run FALSE: FID has no permission to run.
Variation
–
Possible Errors
E_OK
⌋
